official_site: https://empower.abb.com/ecatalog/ec/EN_NA/ (GE Industrial Solutions is now ABB; www.geindustrial.com fails TLS - certificate does not match host)
platform: ABB eCatalog (SAP Commerce/Hybris style; server-rendered HTML, no JSON-LD/og:image). Product URL pattern https://empower.abb.com/ecatalog/ec/EN_NA/p/<CATALOG_NO>; images on https://cdn.productimages.abb.com/<9PAA id>_{100x100|400x400|720x540}.jpg (1000x1000/1500x1500 return 404)
catalog_endpoint: https://empower.abb.com/ecatalog/ec/EN_NA/p/<SKU> (one HTML page per catalog number); regex //cdn\.productimages\.abb\.com/([A-Z0-9]+)_400x400\.jpg
sku_format_match: yes - ABB eCatalog and SuperBreakers both use the GE catalog number verbatim (THQL2120, SRPG600A600, THQB2120GFT)

sample_tests.note: image is named for sibling THQL2160GFT2

official_test_summary: ABB eCatalog: 5 samples tested - THQL2120 and THQB2120GFT have images (3 each); SRPG600A600 and THQC32020WL pages exist without images; TQD32200WL not found. Images max 720x540 (540x540 observed).

alternatives.name: SuperBreakers
alternatives.endpoint: https://superbreakers.com/search/suggest.json?q=<SKU>&resources[type]=product -> https://superbreakers.com/products/<handle>.json (variant.sku exact). Also /collections/general-electric/products.json?limit=250&page=N (1,475 products, vendor "General Electric") - but many GE breakers are under vendor "ABB / General Electric" not in that collection
alternatives.notes: 12/12 samples found by exact variant SKU via suggest+product JSON. Each product has 2 variants: "<SKU>" (New) and "<SKU>-R" (Re-Certified). Store /products.json exceeds 20,000 products (80 pages at 250 still full), vendors incl. General Electric 791 and ABB 628 in first 20k. Beware "BE-<SKU>" items = "rating plug equivalent" (non-genuine) - exclude. Images are clean studio shots on light grey, no watermark observed, originals 3840x3840 (Shopify CDN, &width= resizing works). Some secondary images belong to sibling SKUs (THQL2120 images 2-3 are THQL2170).

recommended_strategy: Primary: SuperBreakers Shopify. For each SKU GET /search/suggest.json?q=<SKU>&resources[type]=product&resources[limit]=5, then /products/<handle>.json for each candidate; accept the product whose variant.sku == SKU exactly (ignore "-R" and "BE-" prefixed). Use product.images[0].src (first image is SKU-named). ~0.6-1s between requests. Secondary/official check: ABB eCatalog /p/<SKU> and take cdn.productimages.abb.com/<id>_720x540.jpg where present (lower res, many SKUs imageless).
notes: Official ABB images exist only for part of the catalog and are small (<=720x540). SuperBreakers is a reseller (sells new + re-certified), not an authorized distributor as far as observed.
